title: Improved bound on low degree mass
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to $\{-1,1\}$, and let $\eta,\tau>0$ and $k\in\mathbb N$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over sets $S$ with $|S|\le k$ that are not contained in the coordinates whose influence is at least $\tau$ is at most $(\eta/(2+\eta))^{-k}\tau^{1/(1+\eta)}I(f)$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$.
